newsitem.title: KENYA: Plane crashes in Kenya, eight feared dead.
newsitem.headline: Plane crashes in Kenya, eight feared dead.

text.p: A plane crashed into hills just west of the Kenyan capital Nairobi on Wednesday and all eight passengers and crew were feared dead, aviation sources said.
They said the Chieftain plane crashed in poor visibility near Ngong town in the Ngong hills shortly after takeoff from Nairobi's Wilson Airport en route for Mwanza, Tanzania.
The plane was operated by a Somali company, Kismayo Airlines. No details were immediately available on the identities and nationalities of passengers and crew.
The sources said a helicopter had been sent to the site to investigate. Pilots at Wilson Airport said extra care was required to pass safely over the Ngong hills in bad weather.
